title: Dems Need High Turnout in Texas, Says Wendy Davis
description:
Wendy Davis, a former Democratic state senator in Texas, says that having the midterm RNC Convention in Dallas will benefit Democrats by tying Republicans to the increasingly unpopular Trump administration. Davis also says redistricting in Texas could hurt the GOP. She speaks with Bloomberg's Julie Fine and Kailey Leinz in Dallas.
